policy: Keep the80%scale floor. At small viewports, clipping with scrolling and a visible size warning is allowed; lowering the fit floor is not an accepted fix.
limitations: Reference photo affine resizing is not calibrated hardware geometry.
Color/illumination are engineering approximations, not measured LED photometry or verified blink behavior.
Round2 screenshots are review evidence; they do not establish final frozen-source geometry or a4px compliance claim.
